positions.label: Sector 1 Reactor
tips: The Gold Saucer date is decided by hidden affection that starts now (Aerith 50, Tifa 30, Yuffie 10, Barret 0). Dialogue choices from here until the Keystone move it — keep the standings honest with the ± buttons as you go.

positions.label: Sector 5 & Wall Market
tips: Wall Market before Corneo's mansion: five one-shot picks (dress, wig, tiara, cologne, underwear). The full best set guarantees Corneo picks Cloud — the dress and wig matter most.
Everything in Wall Market shuts once you enter the mansion; do the shopping loop first, then the Honey Bee Inn, then the dressmaker's shop to change.

positions.label: Shinra HQ
tips: Three one-shot pickups on the climb: the Fl.63 coupons, Elemental (Fl.62 password), Enemy Skill (Fl.67 lab). Elemental gets a second chance during the Disc 2 raid; the others do not.

positions.label: Kalm & the World Map
tips: Yuffie can be met in any forest from here on. Say the right things (never 'Wait!' when she offers to leave) or she robs you and runs.

positions.label: Chocobo Farm & Mythril Mine
tips: Buy a Chocobo Lure and say 'Wark' to the birds for Choco/Mog. Stables can be rented now too — the breeding chain is scheduled for Disc 2, but nothing stops an early start.
Fort Condor's first battle is live; each Condor battle expires quietly as the story moves on.

positions.label: Junon
tips: The send-off performance is graded: 100 points is the only way to the Force Stealer. Practice the parade first — its reward is graded too.
Enemy Skill #2 is lying on the floor of the house beside the respectable inn.

positions.label: Costa del Sol & Corel
tips: Nothing here closes. Mt. Corel's chests are revisitable; the villa is flavor. Save your gil for stables and the Sneak Glove.

positions.label: Gold Saucer & Gongaga
tips: Ramuh is on the floor of the Chocobo Square jockeys' room. With the Buggy, the Sleeping Man's cave near Junon gives Mythril — trade it at the Weapon Seller for Great Gospel before the Temple.

positions.label: Cosmo Canyon & Nibelheim
tips: The Cave of the Gi is a one-time dungeon: sweep it. Nibelheim's safe (Vincent, Odin, Cosmo Memory) and Mt. Nibel's Materia Keeper (Trine) are the other stops.

positions.label: Rocket Town & Wutai
tips: Talk to the old man in Rocket Town for the Yoshiyuki before the plot moves. Wutai: Yuffie's pagoda and the Turtle's Paradise prize once all six flyers are read.
The Gold Saucer date happens right after this beat — the standings lock when you pick up the Keystone.

positions.label: Temple of the Ancients
tips: One visit only: Morph (the only one in the game), Luck Plus, Ribbon, Princess Guard (clock hand IV), Bahamut from the Red Dragon. Aerith's limit levels must be earned before the end of this beat.

positions.label: Forgotten City
tips: Kujata drifts through the Sleeping Forest; Enemy Skill #3 is in the house with the bed. Vlakorados roams near Bone Village — the Carob Nut source.

positions.label: Icicle Inn & Great Glacier
tips: Gaea's Cliff is one-time (and Stilva there is the last Trine source). Alexander: touch the hot spring, then beat the Snow woman. Wonderful chocobos live on the Icicle tracks.

positions.label: Whirlwind Maze
tips: No return trip: Neo Bahamut on the path, MP Turbo, Kaiser Knuckle and Poison Ring in the maze.

positions.label: Junon Escape — the Highwind
tips: Free flight. The breeding chain runs in legs: catch and race, breed, then fight ten or so battles elsewhere before the next breed — interleave it with everything else on the list.

positions.label: Mideel
tips: Contain from the white chocobo (Samolen greens, then scratch behind its ears) and the Curse Ring behind the locked door. Both are usually still reachable in ruined Mideel — the pack closes them early until verified.

positions.label: Huge Materia Hunt
tips: Four one-shot minigames. In the Underwater Reactor tunnel, morph a Ghost Ship for the Guide Book. The Sunken Gelnika is open from here: Hades, Double Cut, Conformer, Highwind, Outsider, Spirit Lance, Heaven's Cloud.

positions.label: Lifestream & Cloud's Return
tips: Chase Ultimate Weapon with the Highwind for the Ultima Weapon; its fall opens the Ancient Forest. Final Heaven needs Tifa leading the party at her piano.

positions.label: Return to Midgar
tips: The raid is one pass through the tunnels: Missing Score needs Barret in the party on the stairs to Proud Clod; W-Item is off the winding tunnel. Wall Market's shops (Premium Heart, Sneak Glove) and Shinra HQ's Elemental are on the route.
After the raid, dig the Key to Sector 5 in Bone Village to reopen the slums and Wall Market.

positions.label: Northern Crater Rim
tips: Superboss loadout check: KotR + W-Summon, HP Absorb linked to KotR, Underwater for Emerald, Mime, Final Attack + Phoenix. Nothing in the crater rim closes.

positions.label: Crater Descent
tips: The first Dragon Zombie to die casts Pandora's Box exactly once per save — have every Enemy Skill materia you care about equipped before the fight.

positions.label: Point of No Return
tips: Last save point before the end. Anything still open on this list is now or never.

trackers.name: Gold Saucer date
trackers.notes: Whoever leads when the party is stranded at the Gold Saucer with the Keystone takes Cloud out (ties break Aerith > Tifa > Yuffie > Barret). Dialogue choices, whose side you take, party picks and who Corneo chooses all move these numbers. The starting values are the game's own; the swings are not modelled yet — log them with ± from a date guide as you play.
